title: fix: adapt Scalar 1.74.0 to keep docs navigation clear
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated the API docs’ pinned Scalar bundle from 1.73.1 to 1.74.0 and adapted the sidebar to its changed markup. The four navigation groups open once when the docs load, while remaining collapsible; group titles stay amber and menu icons align with the tree lines. Hid Scalar’s SDK/MCP promotions and “Ask AI Agent” form while retaining the request tester and language picker. “Show more” buttons are now gray and left-aligned.
